sanskrit_verse: चाषांश् च रक्तपादांश् च सौनं वल्लूरम् एव च / मत्स्यांश् च कामतो जग्ध्वा सोपवासस् त्र्यहं वसेत् ।। यज्ञस्मृतिः १.१७५
transliteration: cāṣāṃś ca raktapādāṃś ca saunaṃ vallūram eva ca / matsyāṃś ca kāmato jagdhvā sopavāsas tryahaṃ vaset // YajñS_1.175
sph_interpretive_translation: One who intentionally consumes meat from birds, red-footed animals, aquatic creatures, or fish shall reside in a state of conscious fasting for three days as completion of energetic purification.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from the purity of action and consumption
Causation arises through volitional ingestion and its vibrational consequence
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by awareness at time of consumption
Restoration logic operates through temporal purification aligned with intent
Consciousness alignment occurs via withdrawal from lower-vibration substances
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent knowingly ingests specified meats THEN initiate 72-hour conscious fasting protocol
IF ingestion was involuntary OR unaware THEN no restoration cycle required
IF agent completes conscious fasting without resistance THEN energetic balance restored
IF agent refuses conscious fasting THEN automatic restriction from sacred participation until compliance
IF ingestion occurred under spiritual guidance THEN substitute fasting with guided meditation equivalent
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, dietary transgressions must be evaluated based on volition, knowledge, and impact on societal dharma. The court shall not impose punitive measures but mandate restoration through prescribed conscious fasting, ensuring alignment with individual capacity and social harmony.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that ingestion creates causal vibration; anupūrvaśaḥ shows how impurity manifests across subtle layers; proportional responsibility aligns with awareness during act; non-punitive reality rule confirms correction lies in conscious reversal, not suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate 72-hour conscious fasting period with structured reflection sessions
Assign mentorship to ensure adherence without coercion
Post-fast integration ritual to reaffirm alignment with higher consciousness
Document energetic shift through self-reported clarity metrics
Reintegrate individual upon verified completion without stigma
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. Meat-induced imbalance corrected through conscious fasting. Justice served through restoration, not punishment. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness is the ultimate adjudicator.
